name: 993 front impact support, AlSi10Mg graded-core concept (PicoGK)
picogk_enhancement: Shell, plate and cruciform core as one filleted body: the core is graded continuously (1.4 to 0.8 mm) instead of four stepped segments, the shell flares into the rear plate as a root fillet, webs are blended into the shell and the open front lip is rounded; the four channels stay open at the front (powder removal, inspection).

length_mm.note: FVD commercial envelope 139 x 100 x 53 mm (SRC-FVD-993-FRONT-IMPACT-TUBE-DIMENSIONS); a product claim, not a drawing

width_mm.note: FVD commercial envelope 139 x 100 x 53 mm; carried by the rear plate

height_mm.note: FVD commercial envelope 139 x 100 x 53 mm; carried by the rear plate

published_mass_g.note: FVD claim about 145 g, corroborated by PorscheFanatics; reference only, not used by the geometry

base_plate_mm.note: same 3 mm solid rear plate as the build123d F0 (front_impact_support.py); no mounting holes

plate_corner_radius_mm.note: plate corner radius; the F0 plate had sharp corners

shell_semi_axis_y_mm.note: F0 elliptic crush shell 60 x 38 mm

shell_semi_axis_z_mm.note: F0 elliptic crush shell 60 x 38 mm

core_t_rear_mm.note: F0 cruciform core thickness at the plate (first segment)

core_t_front_mm.note: F0 cruciform core thickness at the front (last segment); graded linearly here

root_flare_mm.note: extra shell radius at the plate, decaying along X (root fillet)

root_flare_length_mm.note: decay length of the root flare

web_fillet_mm.note: blend radius between core webs and shell

front_lip_round_mm.note: rounding of the open front lip

open_interfaces: bumper beam attachment (holes, datums, fasteners) - not measured, intentionally absent
body rail attachment - not measured, intentionally absent
crash load case, force-displacement target and material card - undefined
status: F0 concept geometry - not fitted, not tested, not safe, not released, not a print file; crash-relevant part: manufacture, fitting, driving and impact testing prohibited pending an approved crash program
